words.sentence1: Her mellifluous voice calmed the crying baby. (Her sweet-sounding voice calmed the crying baby.)
words.sentence2: The cello produced a mellifluous tone that filled the room. (The cello produced a sweet-sounding tone that filled the room.)

words.sentence1: Una dulce melancolia invadio su alma al ver el viejo album. (A sweet melancholy invaded his soul upon seeing the old album.)
words.sentence2: La musica de violin evoca una profunda melancolia. (The violin music evokes a deep melancholy.)

words.sentence1: Cette plage isolee ressemble au paradis. (This isolated beach looks like paradise.)
words.sentence2: Leurs vacances dans les montagnes etaient un vrai paradis. (Their vacation in the mountains was a true paradise.)

words.translation: deep longing, yearining for a far away place
words.sentence1: Er spürte eine grosse Sehnsucht nach seiner Heimat. (He felt a great longing for his homeland.)
words.sentence2: Ihre Lieder voller Sehnsucht beruhrten alle Herzen. (Her songs full of yearning touched all hearts.)

words.sentence1: Mori no naka de utsukushii komorebi o mita. (I saw beautiful sunlight filtering through trees in the forest.)
words.sentence2: Komorebi no naka o aruku no ga suki desu. (I like walking in the sunlight filtering through trees.)

words.sentence1: Il Colosseo e una vera meraviglia del mondo. (The Colosseum is a true wonder of the world.)
words.sentence2: I suoi occhi brillavano di meraviglia. (His eyes shone with wonder.)

words.sentence1: Ta de xiao rong zhen tianmi. (Her smile is really sweet.)
words.sentence2: Women you yi ge tianmi de huiyi. (We have a sweet memory.)

words.translation: to yearn for, to miss dearly

words.sentence2: Gajokdeureul geuriwohaneun maeumeun nunmulgyeopda. (The heart yearning for family is tearful.)

words.sentence1: Samleng sorsor robor galich dael photh sneh. (The gentle whisper of the breeze carries love.)

words.sentence2: Ek het net 'n sagte fluistering gehoor. (I only heard a soft whispering.)
